scanNote:
3-UNITNING IKKINCHI BETI (19-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Shop till you Drop!' va binafsha-ko'k yorliqda oq '3'.

CHAP USTUN:
4) 'Look at the title of the article below. What do you think the article is about?'
5) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Look at the pictures on p. 18, then listen and tick the three places the speaker mentions.'
• Katta to'q sariq 'Reading' sarlavhasi.
6) a) 'Read the article and match the headings to the correct paragraphs.' To'rt sarlavha ikki ustunda: A Recommendation; B Opening Hours; C A Shopper's Paradise; D Places to Go and Things to Buy.
Ostida KO'K fonli maqola - fonda EYFEL MINORASI surati. Sarlavha to'q sariq harflar bilan: 'EXOTIC SHOPPING IN PARIS'. Matn oq harflarda, to'rt xatboshi; har birining oldida raqam va BO'Sh KATAKChA (1, 2, 3, 4).
   b) 'Ask and answer questions based on the text, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya namuna dialog (S1, S2, S3).

O'NG USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Language Development' sarlavhasi.
7) 'Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: fashion, rare, designer, shopper's, high, bank, woollen, autumn, department, antique. Ikki ustunda 10 nuqtali qator.
8) 'Fill in the synonyms from the list.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: chance, trendy, plenty of, a wide range of, fantastic. Ikki ustunda 5 band.
9) 'Fill in the correct words from the list.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: line, offer, suit, buy, miss. Beshta gap.
10) 'Fill in the correct prepositions, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' To'rt ibora bir xatboshida.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': a) 'Suggest another title for the article.' b) 'Read the text again and take notes under the following headings. Then, talk about shopping in Paris.' To'rtta ko'k band: name of city - location; best shops - where they are - things to buy; opening hours - sales; recommendation.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '19'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the title of the article below. What do you think the article is about?
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi maqolaning sarlavhasiga qarang. Sizningcha, maqola nima haqida?
exercises.explanationUz:
SARLAVHAGA QARAB TAXMIN QILISh.

  Sarlavha: 'EXOTIC SHOPPING IN PARIS'

  ⚠ Bu - 'predicting' usuli: matnni
  o'qishdan OLDIN nima haqida ekanini
  taxmin qilish. Taxmin qilgan o'quvchi
  matnni tezroq va yaxshiroq tushunadi.


⚠ 'EXOTIC':

  = g'ayrioddiy, chet ellik, o'ziga xos.
  ⚠ /ɪɡˈzɒtɪk/ deb o'qiladi - 'x'
  'gz' bo'lib eshitiladi.

  ⚠ Odatda uzoq, issiq mamlakatlar
  haqida aytiladi. Bu yerda 'odatdan
  tashqari, qiziqarli xarid' ma'nosida.


⚠ 'SHOPPING' - -ING ShAKLI OT SIFATIDA:

  'to shop' (xarid qilmoq) → 'shopping'
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN ot: 'a shopping'
  XATO.
  ⚠ 'to go shopping' = xaridga bormoq;
  'to do the shopping' = xarid qilmoq.


⚠ PARIJ NIMASI BILAN MAShHUR:

  moda, atir, antikvariat, kitob
  rastalari, univermaglar (Galleries
  Lafayette), dizayner uylari (Chanel,
  Dior, Cartier).

items.en: Look at the title: 'Exotic Shopping in Paris'. What do you think the article is about?
items.uz: Sarlavhaga qarang: 'Parijda g'ayrioddiy xarid'. Sizningcha, maqola nima haqida?
items.answerEn: I think it is about the best shops in Paris and the things you can buy there.
items.answerUz: Menimcha, u Parijdagi eng yaxshi do'konlar va u yerdan nima sotib olish mumkinligi haqida.

items.answerEn: It means unusual and interesting, not like ordinary shopping.
items.answerUz: U g'ayrioddiy va qiziqarli degani - oddiy xariddan farqli.

exercises.audioRequiredUz: So'zlovchi qaysi UCH joyni tilga olishi faqat audioda aytiladi.
exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures on p. 18, then listen and tick the three places the speaker mentions.
exercises.instructionUz: 18-betdagi suratlarga qarang, so'ng tinglang va so'zlovchi tilga olgan uchta joyni belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
18-BETDAGI YETTI DO'KON:

  A - a jeweller's
  B - a chemist's
  C - an antique shop
  D - a lace shop
  E - a confectioner's
  F - a greengrocer's
  G - a bookstall

  * ⚠ So'zlovchi qaysi uchtasini tilga
    oladi - faqat AUDIODAN.


⚠ 'TO MENTION':

  = tilga olmoq, eslatib o'tmoq.
  ⚠ 'to mention sth' - predlogsiz:
  'He mentioned the shop'
  ('mentioned about' XATO).


⚠ 'TO TICK':

  = belgi qo'ymoq (✓).
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'tick', AQShda 'check'.
  ⚠ 12-betdagi 4-mashqda ham 'tick'
  ishlatilgan edi.


⚠ TINGLAShGA TAYYoRGARLIK:

  Har do'konning KALIT so'zlarini
  oldindan o'ylang:
     jeweller's - ring, gold, necklace
     chemist's - medicine, painkillers
     antique shop - old, furniture
     lace shop - tablecloth, lace
     confectioner's - chocolate, sweets
     greengrocer's - fruit, vegetables
     bookstall - books, magazines

  ⚠ Shunda birinchi kalit so'z
  eshitilishi bilan javob topiladi.

points.en: A - a jeweller's
points.uz: A - zargarlik do'koni
points.noteUz:
⚠ Tilga olinganmi - AUDIODAN.
⚠ Kalit so'zlar: ring, gold, necklace, diamond.

points.en: B - a chemist's
points.uz: B - dorixona
points.noteUz:
⚠ Tilga olinganmi - AUDIODAN.
⚠ Kalit so'zlar: medicine, painkillers, hairspray.

points.en: C - an antique shop
points.uz: C - antikvariat do'koni
points.noteUz:
⚠ Tilga olinganmi - AUDIODAN.
⚠ Kalit so'zlar: old furniture, collectors.

points.en: D - a lace shop
points.uz: D - to'r do'koni
points.noteUz:
⚠ Tilga olinganmi - AUDIODAN.
⚠ Kalit so'zlar: lace, tablecloths.

points.en: E - a confectioner's
points.uz: E - shirinlik do'koni
points.noteUz:
⚠ Tilga olinganmi - AUDIODAN.
⚠ Kalit so'zlar: chocolate, pralines, sweets.

points.en: F - a greengrocer's
points.uz: F - meva-sabzavot do'koni
points.noteUz:
⚠ Tilga olinganmi - AUDIODAN.
⚠ Kalit so'zlar: apples, grapes, vegetables.

points.en: G - a bookstall
points.uz: G - kitob rastasi
points.noteUz:
⚠ Tilga olinganmi - AUDIODAN.
⚠ Kalit so'zlar: rare books, the River Seine.

exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI
bandlarda berilgan.


⚠ MATNNING TUZILIShI:

  1-xatboshi - umumiy fikr: Parij -
     xaridorning jannati
  2-xatboshi - qayerga borish va nima
     sotib olish
  3-xatboshi - ish vaqti va chegirmalar
  4-xatboshi - tavsiya

  ⚠ Bu 6a mashqining javobi.


⚠ MATNDAGI PARIJ JOYLARI:

  Bonaparte Street, Jacob Street -
     antikvariat do'konlari
  the River Seine - Sena daryosi;
     qirg'og'ida kitob rastalari
  Galleries Lafayette - Parijning eng
     katta univermagi
  Boulevard Haussmann - Galleries
     Lafayette turgan ko'cha
  The Marais - modabop butiklar tumani
  Rue de Rivoli - zargarlik va moda
     uylari ko'chasi
  Cartier, Chanel, Nina Ricci,
     Christian Dior - mashhur moda uylari


⚠ MATNDA 21-BETDAGI HARRODS
MATNIGA O'XShASh TUZILISh BOR:

  ikkalasi ham do'kon haqida, ikkalasida
  ham 'a wide range of' va 'high quality'
  iboralari bor.

points.en: [1] Paris, the capital of France, is a shopper's paradise, with plenty of large department stores as well as thousands of delightful smaller shops.
points.uz: [1] Fransiya poytaxti Parij - xaridorning jannati: bu yerda ko'plab katta univermaglar va minglab yoqimli kichik do'konlar bor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'the capital of France' - IZOh, verguller
bilan ajratiladi.
⚠ "a shopper's paradise" - egalik apostrofi.
⚠ 'plenty of' = ko'p (8-mashqda sinonimi).
⚠ 'as well as' = shuningdek, ... dan tashqari.
⚠ 'delightful' = yoqimli.

points.en: [2] Antique lovers can find fantastic furniture in the small antique shops on Bonaparte and Jacob Streets, and collectors can find rare books on the bookstalls lining the banks of the River Seine.
points.uz: [2] Antikvariat ixlosmandlari Bonapart va Jakob ko'chalaridagi kichik antikvariat do'konlaridan ajoyib mebel topa oladi, kolleksionerlar esa Sena daryosi qirg'og'i bo'ylab tizilgan kitob rastalaridan noyob kitoblar topadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a lover' bu yerda = ixlosmand ('sevishgan'
emas).
⚠ 'furniture' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot ('furnitures'
XATO).
⚠ 'to line' = qator bo'lib tizilmoq (9-mashqda).
⚠ 'the banks OF the river' - daryo qirg'og'i.

points.en: [2] There are also some great department stores which sell everything from perfume to furniture.
points.uz: [2] Yana atirdan mebelgacha hamma narsani sotadigan zo'r univermaglar bor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'which' - nisbiy olmosh (12-unit mavzusi).
⚠ 'everything FROM ... TO ...' - keng qamrovni
ko'rsatuvchi qolip.

points.en: [2] Galleries Lafayette, Paris' largest department store on Boulevard Haussmann, offers a great variety of high quality woollen skirts, leather jackets and designer clothes.
points.uz: [2] Bulvar Osmandagi Parijning eng katta univermagi Galeri Lafayet yuqori sifatli jun yubkalar, charm kurtkalar va dizayner kiyimlarining katta turini taklif etadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ "Paris'" - 's' bilan tugagan otga egalik:
faqat APOSTROF.
⚠ 'to offer' = taklif etmoq (9-mashqda).
⚠ 'a great variety of' = katta tur (8-mashqda
sinonimi).

points.en: [2] The Marais is a group of little streets with some of the trendiest boutiques. There you can buy fashionable clothes, shoes and jewellery.
points.uz: [2] Mare - eng modabop butiklar joylashgan kichik ko'chalar guruhi. U yerdan modabop kiyim, poyabzal va taqinchoq sotib olish mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'trendiest' - 'trendy' ning eng yuqori
darajasi (undosh + y → -iest).
⚠ 'jewellery' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot; Britaniya
imlosi (AQShda 'jewelry').

points.en: [2] For shoppers with big bank accounts, there is a wide range of jewellers' and designer fashion houses along the Rue de Rivoli, such as Cartier, Chanel, Nina Ricci and Christian Dior.
points.uz: [2] Katta bank hisobiga ega xaridorlar uchun Rivoli ko'chasi bo'ylab Cartier, Chanel, Nina Ricci va Christian Dior kabi zargarlik do'konlari va moda uylarining keng turi bor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a bank account' = bank hisobi.
⚠ 'a wide range of' = keng tur (8-mashqda).
⚠ 'such as' = ... kabi (misol keltirish).
⚠ "jewellers'" - KO'PLIKDA egalik: apostrof
-S dan KEYIN.

points.en: [3] Shops in Paris are usually open from eight or ten in the morning till about seven in the evening, from Monday to Saturday.
points.uz: [3] Parijdagi do'konlar odatda dushanbadan shanbagacha ertalab sakkiz yoki o'ndan kechqurun yettilargacha ochiq.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'from ... till ...' - vaqt oralig'i
(10-mashqda).
⚠ 'IN the morning', 'IN the evening' -
predlog 'in'.
⚠ 'from Monday TO Saturday' - kunlar oralig'i.

points.en: [3] The big sales come after Christmas and before the autumn collections.
points.uz: [3] Katta chegirmalar Rojdestvodan keyin va kuzgi kolleksiyalardan oldin bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a sale' = chegirma, arzonlashtirilgan savdo.
⚠ 'the autumn collection' = kuzgi kolleksiya
(7-mashqda).
⚠ Britaniyada 'autumn', AQShda 'fall'.

points.en: [4] Don't miss the chance to go shopping in Paris. There is always something to suit everyone's pocket and taste.
points.uz: [4] Parijda xaridga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang. Har kimning hamyoni va didiga mos narsa doim topiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to miss the chance' = imkoniyatni boy bermoq
(9-mashqda).
⚠ 'to suit sb' = mos kelmoq (9-mashqda).
⚠ 'pocket' bu yerda ko'chma ma'noda = hamyon,
pul imkoniyati.
⚠ 'everyone's' - egalik apostrofi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article and match the headings to the correct paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani o'qing va sarlavhalarni to'g'ri xatboshilarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT SARLAVHA - TO'RT XATBOShI.

  A  Recommendation - tavsiya
  B  Opening Hours - ish vaqti
  C  A Shopper's Paradise - xaridorning
     jannati
  D  Places to Go and Things to Buy -
     borish joylari va sotib oladigan
     narsalar


QANDAY TOPILADI:

  1-xatboshi: 'Paris ... is a SHOPPER'S
     PARADISE' - sarlavha AYNAN matnda!
     → C

  2-xatboshi: ko'chalar nomi va nima
     sotilishi → D

  3-xatboshi: 'are usually OPEN FROM
     eight ... TILL seven' → B

  4-xatboshi: "DON'T MISS the chance" -
     maslahat, buyruq gapi → A

  ⚠ Tavsiya (recommendation) HAR DOIM
  oxirgi xatboshida bo'ladi - 9-betdagi
  Susanning xatida ham shunday edi.


⚠ 'A RECOMMENDATION':

  = tavsiya.
  ⚠ 'to recommend' - BITTA 'c', IKKI 'm'.
  ⚠ 'accommodation' bilan adashtirmang
  (u IKKI 'c', IKKI 'm').

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Sarlavha AYNAN matnda bor:
"Paris ... is a shopper's PARADISE".

⚠ Bu - eng oson topiladigani.

pairs.right: D - Places to Go and Things to Buy
pairs.rightUz: D - Borish joylari va sotib oladigan narsalar
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Xatboshida KO'ChA NOMLARI (Bonaparte,
Jacob, Rue de Rivoli) va SOTILADIGAN NARSALAR
(furniture, books, skirts, jewellery) bor.

⚠ Eng UZUN xatboshi - chunki ikki mavzuni
qamraydi.

⚠ 'are usually OPEN FROM eight ... TILL about
seven' - aynan ish vaqti.

⚠ 'opening hours' = ish vaqti (do'kon, muzey).

⚠ "DON'T MISS the chance" - BUYRUQ gapi,
maslahat.

⚠ Tavsiya HAR DOIM oxirgi xatboshida.

exercises.instructionEn: Ask and answer questions based on the text, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  S1: Where can you find antique shops?
  S2: On Bonaparte and Jacob Streets.
      Which is Paris' largest department
      store?
  S3: Galleries Lafayette. What can you
      buy there?

  ⚠ ZANJIRLI SAVOL: har o'quvchi avval
  javob beradi, keyin YaNGI savol
  beradi. Bu - butun sinfni jalb
  qiladigan usul.


⚠ 'WHICH' va 'WHAT':

  'WHICH is Paris' largest store?'
     - CHEKLANGAN tanlovdan (Parijdagi
       do'konlar ichidan)
  'WHAT can you buy there?'
     - CHEKSIZ tanlovdan


⚠ 'ON ... STREET':

  Britaniyada 'IN Bonaparte Street',
  AQShda 'ON Bonaparte Street'.
  ⚠ Matnda 'ON' ishlatilgan.

items.question: Where can you find antique shops?
items.whyUz:
Kitobdagi NAMUNA.

⚠ Ko'cha nomi oldidan 'ON' (AQSh varianti).

items.question: Which is Paris' largest department store?
items.whyUz:
Kitobdagi NAMUNA.

⚠ "Paris'" - 's' bilan tugagan otga egalik:
faqat apostrof.

items.prompt: U yerdan nima sotib olish mumkin?
items.question: What can you buy there?
items.answer: High quality woollen skirts, leather jackets and designer clothes.
items.whyUz:
Kitobdagi NAMUNA.

⚠ 'high quality' - defissiz, chunki ikki so'z
birga sifat.

items.question: Where can you find rare books?
items.answer: On the bookstalls lining the banks of the River Seine.

items.question: What is The Marais?
items.answer: It's a group of little streets with some of the trendiest boutiques.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'trendiest' - eng yuqori daraja.
⚠ 'some of the trendiest' = eng modabop
butiklarning ba'zilari.

items.question: When are the shops open?
items.answer: From eight or ten in the morning till about seven in the evening, from Monday to Saturday.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'from ... till ...' - vaqt oralig'i.
⚠ Yakshanba KUNI yopiq - matnda 'from Monday
to Saturday' deyilgan.

items.question: When do the big sales come?
items.answer: After Christmas and before the autumn collections.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA MAQOLADA BOR.

  ⚠ Bu yana COLLOCATION mashqi: qaysi
  sifat/ot qaysi ot bilan yuradi.


⚠ 'A(N)' BELGISI - MUHIM YoRDAM:

  1, 4-bandlarda 'a(n)' bor → ot
  BIRLIKDA va SANALADIGAN.
  Qolganlarida artikl yo'q → ko'plik
  yoki sanalmaydigan.

  ⚠ 'a(n)' yozilgani - keyingi so'z
  unli bilan boshlanishi ham mumkin
  degani.


⚠ OT + OT BIRIKMASI:

  Ko'p javob SIFAT emas, OT:
     a SHOPPER'S paradise
     ANTIQUE lovers
     a DEPARTMENT store
     BANK accounts
     FASHION houses
     AUTUMN collections

  ⚠ Birinchi ot SIFAT vazifasini
  bajaradi va HAR DOIM BIRLIKDA
  qoladi: 'bank accountS' ('banks
  accounts' XATO).


⚠ 'HIGH QUALITY':

  = yuqori sifat.
  ⚠ 'good quality' ham to'g'ri.
  ⚠ 'quality' SANALMAYDIGAN.


⚠ 'RARE':

  = noyob, kam uchraydigan.
  ⚠ 'a rare book' = noyob kitob.
  ⚠ Yana 'rarely' = kamdan-kam
  (14-betdagi 12-mashqda).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the synonyms from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
SINONIMLAR - BIR XIL MA'NOLI SO'ZLAR.

  ⚠ Chap tomonda ODDIY so'z, o'ng
  tomonda MAQOLADAGI so'z.

  ⚠ Bu usul lug'atni ikki barobar
  kengaytiradi: bir ma'no - ikki so'z.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  fashionable = trendy
     (modabop)
  a great variety of = a wide range of
     (katta tur, keng tanlov)
  wonderful = fantastic
     (ajoyib)
  an opportunity = a chance
     (imkoniyat)
  a lot of = plenty of
     (ko'p)


⚠ 'TRENDY':

  = zamonaviy, modabop.
  ⚠ 'a trend' (moda yo'nalishi) so'zidan.
  ⚠ 'trendy' - so'zlashuv uslubi;
  'fashionable' - neytral.


⚠ 'PLENTY OF' va 'A LOT OF':

  Ikkalasi ham 'ko'p' degani va
  sanaladigan hamda sanalmaydigan
  otlar bilan ishlatiladi.

  ⚠ 'plenty of' biroz ko'proq ta'kid
  beradi: 'yetarlicha ko'p'.
  ⚠ 'of' ni TUShIRMANG.


⚠ 'A CHANCE' va 'AN OPPORTUNITY':

  a chance - imkoniyat; tasodif
  an opportunity - imkoniyat (rasmiyroq)

  ⚠ Matnda: "Don't miss the CHANCE."
  ⚠ 'by chance' = tasodifan.


⚠ 'A RANGE' va 'A VARIETY':

  a wide range of - keng tanlov
  a great variety of - katta tur

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham do'kon va mahsulot
  haqida ishlatiladi - reklama tili.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct words from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh FE'L - HAMMASI MAQOLADA BOR.

  buy   - sotib olmoq
  line  - qator bo'lib tizilmoq
  suit  - mos kelmoq
  miss  - boy bermoq; sog'inmoq
  offer - taklif etmoq


⚠ 'TO LINE' - G'ALATI FE'L:

  'a line' (ot) = chiziq, qator
  'to line' (fe'l) = qator bo'lib
     tizilmoq, chetini qoplamoq

  ⚠ Matnda: 'the bookstalls LINING the
  banks of the River Seine' = daryo
  qirg'og'i bo'ylab TIZILGAN kitob
  rastalari.


⚠ 'TO SUIT' - UCh MA'NO:

  1) mos kelmoq (did, hamyon):
     'something to SUIT everyone's taste'
  2) yarashmoq (kiyim):
     'That dress suits you.'
  3) 'a suit' (ot) = kostyum

  ⚠ 'to suit' va 'to fit' FARQI:
     suit - yarashadi (rang, uslub)
     fit  - to'g'ri keladi (o'lcham)


⚠ 'TO MISS' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) boy bermoq, o'tkazib yubormoq:
     "Don't MISS the chance."
     'I missed the bus.'
  2) sog'inmoq:
     'I miss my family.'


⚠ 'TO OFFER':

  = taklif etmoq, taqdim etmoq.
  ⚠ Matnda: 'Galleries Lafayette ...
  OFFERS a great variety'.
  ⚠ 'an offer' (ot) = taklif -
  8-betdagi modul rejasida ham bor edi.


⚠ 'DURING THE BIG SALES':

  'during' = davomida.
  ⚠ 'during' + OT ('during the sales');
  'while' + GAP ('while I was shopping').

items.sentence: You can ___ cheap clothes during the big sales.
items.uz: Katta chegirmalar paytida arzon kiyim sotib olish mumkin.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'can' dan keyin fe'l ODDIY shaklda.
⚠ 'during' + OT.

items.sentence: Flower stalls ___ the banks of the river.
items.uz: Gul rastalari daryo qirg'og'i bo'ylab tizilgan.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to line' = qator bo'lib tizilmoq.
⚠ Matnda: 'the bookstalls LINING the banks of
the River Seine'.

items.sentence: At Galleries Lafayette, shoppers can always find something to ___ their taste and pocket.
items.uz: Galeri Lafayetda xaridorlar didi va hamyoniga mos narsa topa oladi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to suit sb/sth' = mos kelmoq.
⚠ 'pocket' ko'chma ma'noda = pul imkoniyati.

items.sentence: Don't ___ the chance to visit the big department stores.
items.uz: Katta univermaglarga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang.
items.whyUz:
⚠ "Don't" dan keyin fe'l ODDIY shaklda.
⚠ 'to miss a chance' = imkoniyatni boy bermoq.

items.sentence: The large department stores ___ a great variety of products.
items.uz: Katta univermaglar mahsulotlarning katta turini taklif etadi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Ega 'The large department stores' - KO'PLIK,
shuning uchun -S YO'Q.
⚠ 'a product' = mahsulot.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct prepositions, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predloglarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR - HAMMASI MAQOLADA BOR.


⚠ KO'ChA NOMI BILAN:

  ON Bonaparte Street (AQSh)
  IN Bonaparte Street (Britaniya)

  ⚠ Matnda 'ON' ishlatilgan.
  ⚠ Manzil bilan esa 'AT':
  'AT 25 Bonaparte Street'.


⚠ 'ON THE BOOKSTALLS':

  ⚠ Rasta - USTIDA narsa turadigan
  yuza, shuning uchun 'ON'.
  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'on the shelf',
  'on the table'.


⚠ 'THE BANKS OF THE RIVER':

  ⚠ 'of' - egalik/tegishlilik.
  ⚠ 'a bank' bu yerda = daryo qirg'og'i
  (BANK muassasasi emas!).

  ⚠ Matnda ikkala ma'no ham bor:
  'the BANKS of the River Seine'
     (qirg'oq)
  'big BANK accounts' (muassasa)


⚠ VAQT ORALIG'I:

  FROM eight IN the morning
  TILL seven IN the evening

  ⚠ 'from ... till/to ...' - juftlik:
  biri bo'lsa ikkinchisi ham ShART.
  ⚠ 'IN the morning/afternoon/evening'
  ⚠ ISTISNO: 'AT night'.

items.whyUz:
⚠ Ko'cha nomi bilan 'ON' (AQSh varianti).
⚠ Britaniyada 'IN Bonaparte Street' ham to'g'ri.

⚠ Matnda 'ON' ishlatilgan.

⚠ Rasta - USTIDA narsa turadigan yuza →
'ON'.
⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'on the shelf', 'on the table'.

⚠ 'of' - tegishlilik.
⚠ 'a bank' bu yerda = daryo QIRG'OG'I,
bank muassasasi EMAS.

items.textEn: 4  ___ eight ___ the morning ___ seven ___ the evening
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'from ... till ...' - juftlik, biri bo'lsa
ikkinchisi ham ShART.
⚠ 'IN the morning', 'IN the evening'.
⚠ ISTISNO: 'AT night'.

exercises.instructionEn: a) Suggest another title for the article. b) Read the text again and take notes under the following headings. Then, talk about shopping in Paris.
exercises.instructionUz: a) Maqolaga boshqa sarlavha taklif qiling. b) Matnni qayta o'qing va quyidagi sarlavhalar ostida qayd oling. So'ng Parijdagi xarid haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
SARLAVHA TAKLIF QILISh VA QAYD OLISh.


⚠ YAXShI SARLAVHA QANDAY BO'LADI:

  • QISQA (3-5 so'z)
  • matnning ASOSIY fikrini beradi
  • qiziqish uyg'otadi

  ⚠ Ko'pincha SO'Z O'YINI yoki IBORA
  ishlatiladi - unit nomi
  'Shop till you Drop!' ham shunday.


TAKLIF QILISh MUMKIN BO'LGAN
SARLAVHALAR:

  'A Shopper's Paradise'
  'Shopping in the City of Fashion'
  'Paris: Something for Everyone'
  'From Antiques to Designer Clothes'


TO'RT SARLAVHA (b qismi):

  1) name of city - location
  2) best shops - where they are -
     things to buy
  3) opening hours - sales
  4) recommendation

  ⚠ Bu - 6a mashqidagi to'rt xatboshi
  bilan AYNI.

  ⚠ Ya'ni maqolaning tuzilishi
  gapirishning ham rejasi bo'ladi.


⚠ QAYD OLIShDA TO'LIQ GAP YoZMANG:

  ✓ Paris - capital of France
  ✗ 'Paris is the capital of France.'

  ⚠ Qayd qancha qisqa bo'lsa, gapirganda
  shuncha erkin bo'lasiz.

points.en: Another title: 'A Shopper's Paradise' or 'Paris: Something for Everyone'
points.uz: Boshqa sarlavha: 'Xaridorning jannati' yoki 'Parij: har kimga bir narsa'
points.noteUz:
⚠ Yaxshi sarlavha QISQA bo'ladi va asosiy
fikrni beradi.

⚠ Ikkinchisi matnning oxirgi gapidan olingan:
'something to suit everyone's pocket and taste'.

points.en: name of city - location: Paris, the capital of France
points.uz: shahar nomi - joylashuvi: Parij, Fransiya poytaxti
points.noteUz:
⚠ Maqolaning 1-xatboshisidan.
⚠ 'the capital of France' - IZOh, verguller
bilan.

points.en: best shops - where they are - things to buy: antique shops on Bonaparte and Jacob Streets (furniture); bookstalls on the banks of the River Seine (rare books); Galleries Lafayette on Boulevard Haussmann (woollen skirts, leather jackets, designer clothes); The Marais (fashionable clothes, shoes, jewellery); Rue de Rivoli (jewellers' and designer fashion houses)
points.uz: eng yaxshi do'konlar - qayerda - nima sotib olish: Bonapart va Jakob ko'chalaridagi antikvariat do'konlari (mebel); Sena qirg'og'idagi kitob rastalari (noyob kitoblar); Bulvar Osmandagi Galeri Lafayet (jun yubka, charm kurtka, dizayner kiyim); Mare (modabop kiyim, poyabzal, taqinchoq); Rivoli ko'chasi (zargarlik va moda uylari)
points.noteUz:
⚠ Maqolaning 2-xatboshisidan - eng UZUN qism.

⚠ Har do'kon uchun: QAYERDA + NIMA SOTILADI.

points.en: opening hours - sales: usually from eight or ten in the morning till about seven in the evening, from Monday to Saturday; big sales after Christmas and before the autumn collections
points.uz: ish vaqti - chegirmalar: odatda dushanbadan shanbagacha ertalab sakkiz yoki o'ndan kechqurun yettilargacha; katta chegirmalar Rojdestvodan keyin va kuzgi kolleksiyalardan oldin
points.noteUz:
⚠ Maqolaning 3-xatboshisidan.
⚠ 'from ... till ...' juftligini ishlating.

points.en: recommendation: Don't miss the chance to go shopping in Paris - there is always something to suit everyone's pocket and taste.
points.uz: tavsiya: Parijda xaridga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang - har kimning hamyoni va didiga mos narsa doim topiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Maqolaning 4-xatboshisidan.
⚠ Tavsiya odatda BUYRUQ gapi bilan beriladi:
"Don't miss ...", 'You should visit ...'

patterns.formula: [Shahar], the capital of [mamlakat], is a shopper's paradise.
patterns.exampleEn: Paris, the capital of France, is a shopper's paradise.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ IZOh verguller bilan ajratiladi.
⚠ "a shopper's paradise" - egalik apostrofi.

patterns.exampleEn: You can find fantastic furniture in the small antique shops on Bonaparte Street.
patterns.exampleUz: Bonapart ko'chasidagi kichik antikvariat do'konlaridan ajoyib mebel topish mumkin.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'IN a shop' (ichida), 'ON a street' (ko'chada).
⚠ 'furniture' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot.

patterns.exampleEn: Galleries Lafayette offers a wide range of designer clothes.
patterns.exampleUz: Galeri Lafayet dizayner kiyimlarining keng turini taklif etadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'a wide range of' = 'a great variety of' -
sinonim (8-mashq).
⚠ Reklama tilining asosiy qolipi.

patterns.formula: Shops are open from ... in the morning till ... in the evening.
patterns.exampleEn: Shops are open from eight in the morning till seven in the evening.
patterns.exampleUz: Do'konlar ertalab sakkizdan kechqurun yettigacha ochiq.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'from ... till ...' - juftlik.
⚠ 'IN the morning/evening'; ISTISNO 'AT night'.

patterns.exampleEn: Don't miss the chance to go shopping in Paris.
patterns.exampleUz: Parijda xaridga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Tavsiya berishning tayyor qolipi.
⚠ 'the chance TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.
